Dome decision-making trial timeline: task-file defaults

Defaults only, not what a mouse runs. This page shows the repo's task files. On a rig, each mouse runs its curriculum stage (K:\config\curricula), whose settings and conditions replace these, so its timings, targets and probes can differ.

Times are seconds from stimulus onset, from . Regenerate with uv run trial-timeline after editing a task file; uv run pytest fails while this page is out of date.
